request: Scale the part 10x. Add drafts of 2 degrees to all vertical surfaces, with flat bottom surface as a hinge. Add rounds R=1mm to all inner edges and R=3mm to all outer edges. Exclude edges, inner or outer, on the flat bottom surface. Add two cylinder features with D=6mm and inner hole D=3mm. Cylinders should be spaced 30mm apart and shall be placed centered with respect to the main part. They should start on the flat bottom surface level and reach all the way to the part wall on the top side

actions.relational_constraint: Apply the same scale factor to the complete part
actions.unresolved_reference: The complete solid or body representing the part must be identified in the CAD model

actions.relational_constraint: Use the flat bottom surface as the draft hinge
actions.unresolved_reference: The vertical surfaces, the flat bottom surface, the model direction defining vertical, and the required draft direction or sign must be resolved from the CAD model

actions.target: all inner edges except inner edges on the flat bottom surface
actions.relational_constraint: Exclude any qualifying inner edge on the flat bottom surface
actions.unresolved_reference: The inner-edge classification and which edges are considered to be on the flat bottom surface must be determined from the CAD model

actions.target: all outer edges except outer edges on the flat bottom surface
actions.relational_constraint: Exclude any qualifying outer edge on the flat bottom surface
actions.unresolved_reference: The outer-edge classification and which edges are considered to be on the flat bottom surface must be determined from the CAD model

actions.relational_constraint: The two cylinders must be spaced 30 mm apart, centered with respect to the main part, start at the level of the flat bottom surface, and extend to the part wall on the top side
actions.unresolved_reference: The main-part center reference, cylinder axes and orientation, exact interpretation of the 30 mm spacing, flat bottom level, and top-side part wall that terminates each cylinder must be identified from the CAD model

actions.operation: Create an inner hole in each cylindrical feature
actions.target: the two newly created cylindrical features
actions.relational_constraint: Place one inner hole within each cylinder
actions.unresolved_reference: The hole-axis alignment and the depth or end condition of each hole are not explicitly stated and must be resolved before modeling
